content.text:
The suite is green, and I fixed the code instead of skipping the test.

The test wasn't flaky. `invoiceDate` in `invoice.js` used local-time getters (`getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`), but its own comment says invoices are dated in UTC. The test sets `TZ=Asia/Tokyo`, so a 23:30Z invoice came out as the next day. That would have been wrong in production on any non-UTC server, not just in CI. I switched to `getUTCFullYear`, `getUTCMonth` and `getUTCDate`.

I haven't run it under any other timezone. The test pins Tokyo, and UTC getters don't depend on the system timezone.
